I've saved that as a project convention in EngramDB, so future sessions and your collaborators will see it: all background jobs go through `jobs.enqueue()`, and nothing calls Celery directly (no `.delay()`, `.apply_async()` or `send_task`).

I searched the repo for an existing `jobs.enqueue()` and for any Celery usage, and found neither. So there's no current code to change, and the wrapper doesn't exist yet. If it's meant to live in this repo, I can scaffold it for you.
